data.text: God, deliver me! LORD, hurry to help me!
data.subtitulo: For the music director. Of David. For remembrance.

data.text: Let those who seek my life be ashamed and humiliated; let those who desire my harm turn back in disgrace.
Let those who say, “Aha! Aha!” turn back because of their shame.
Let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
data.titulo: Joy for All Who Seek God

data.text: But I am poor and needy; God, hurry to me! You are my help and my deliverer; LORD, do not delay.
